name: Lyrics Romanizer
author: Illumye
description: Writes lyrics in Japanese, Korean and Cyrillic scripts in Latin letters, offline, under each line of the songs whose lyrics come without a romanization.
changelog: Myspoti 2.4.0 asks extensions for the romanizations of the lyrics it shows: the extension now answers that way, for the lyrics of every source, Spotify's word-by-word lyrics included, with no network and no access to Spotify.

actions.name: lyrics.romanize
actions.why: Writes Japanese, Korean and Cyrillic lyrics in Latin letters, offline
